description: Obtain the complete Hannu Juusola 1999, Linguistic Peculiarities in the Aramaic Magic Bowl Texts, for controlled language and orthography normalization.
resolution_notes: On 2026-09-18 the researcher supplied a six-page scan containing only the title and imprint pages, acknowledgements, contents, and one blank page; it is deposited privately as CAP-945D9CCAC42D (SHA-256 c0bd6a93857c81d8e8f67e2fbf2ffb971e8bd85e1f336b4d70a4e63ce2ee2bee). The contents run through printed page 263, but all study chapters are absent. Wajsberg's complete 2001 review remains held separately. This lead stays open for the complete monograph.
